# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security problem in [jeddahhub.org](https://jeddahhub.org) or in
this repository, please report it privately. Do **not** open a public issue.

- Email **jeddahglobalshapers@gmail.com** with "Security" in the subject, or
- use the [contact form](https://jeddahhub.org/en/contact) and choose
  "Other".

Please include what you found, the steps to reproduce it, and what an attacker
could do with it. You'll get a reply as soon as possible, usually within a few
days, and a note when it's fixed.

## Scope

- The website and dashboard at `jeddahhub.org` and `www.jeddahhub.org`.
- The code and security rules (`firestore.rules`) in this repository.

Please don't access other people's data, disrupt the service (no load testing
or denial of service), or send spam through the site's forms while testing.

The same contact details are published at
[`/.well-known/security.txt`](https://jeddahhub.org/.well-known/security.txt).
